correctness.rationale: The transport f⋆g=f(t⁻¹)g(t²) gives xθ(y)−yθ(x) with θ(t)=t³. In characteristic five the displayed u has derivative one at t=1 and θ(u)=3u. Independently, if p_ij denotes the minor of the effective four input coordinates, the bracket outputs are 2p_01, 3p_02, p_03+p_12, −p_13. The decomposability relation p_01 p_23−p_02 p_13+p_03 p_12=0 solves freely for p_23 when a≠0. If a=0 and b≠0 it is the quadratic z²−cz−(b/3)d=0 in z=p_12, with discriminant c²+3bd. If a=b=0 choose z=0. The four basis elements are attained individually; splitting off b u² proves width at most two and the nonsquare slice proves the exact dichotomy. For fixed nonzero b and arbitrary c, the discriminant is a bijective affine function of d, yielding the stated census including zero as length zero.
residual_risks: The arbitrary-field conclusion uses the algebraic proof, not enumeration; the finite verifier's F₂₅ count is a discriminant count, not an exhaustive bracket enumeration.
